title: math2 fidelity reviews
description: The file reviews/<shard>/<tag>.yaml. It holds the fidelity reviews of the node with the tag. The shard is the first two characters of the tag. See spec 10.6 and 15.3 in tamnd/math2-agent, and reviews/README.md.

id.description: r-, the tag of the node, - and a number, for example r-3C53TD-01. The tag has 6 or 10 characters. A formal binding of the node lists the id in fidelity_reviews.

decl.description: The declaration that the reviewer read. When the binding has an adapter, it is the adapter.

statement_hash.description: The hash of the informal statement section of the node. m2 review prints it.

type_hash.description: The hash of the elaborated type of decl. m2 review prints it.

conventions.description: The conventions under which the Lean statement says what the informal statement says.

minutes.description: The time of the review in minutes, as the reviewer gives it. m2 review -minutes N writes it, and m2 corpus report adds it to the review hours (corpus K12.5).
